info.title: GA4GH Beacon API Specification for GDI MAP Stage 1 Allele Frequency Browser
info.description: This is a streamlined subset of GA4GH Beacon API Specification v.2.0.0 to support for GDI MAP Stage 1 Allele Frequency Browser

tags.name: Beacon Metadata endpoints
tags.description: Endpoints to get information about the Beacon instance.

get.description: Get information about the beacon. Synonym of /info endpoint. This information is used to populate UIs where description of the beacon, its hosting organitzation, contacts, etc. are required.

schema.description: A `beaconErrorResponse` denotes an unsuccessful operation, e.g. due to a missing parameter or an invalid query. The response contains an error object.

examples: The provided parameters are incomplete: `start` is missing.

schema.description: A `beaconErrorResponse` denotes an unsuccessful operation, e.g. due to a missing parameter or an invalid query. The response contains an error object.

beaconId.description: The Id of a Beacon. Usually a reversed domain string, but any URI is acceptable. The purpose of this attribute is, in the context of a Beacon network, to disambiguate responses coming from different Beacons.
